# Grid (ongrid)

> Reads, measures, checks, draws and changes floor plans kept in one plan file. Grid is an open-source (Apache-2.0) toolkit for AI agents: one plan file, written rooms first, with 33 MCP tools named grid_…. Every report carries the label "General guidance, not your local rules"; no message says a plan complies or is approved. Not published to npm yet (as of 23 November 2026).

## Start here

- [Home](https://ongrid.example/index.html): what Grid is and a first plan
- [llms-full.txt](https://ongrid.example/llms-full.txt): the README and the guide for agents in one file
- [The guide for agents](https://github.com/ongrid-arch/grid/blob/main/docs/agent-guide.md): write a first plan rooms first
- [The tool server](https://github.com/ongrid-arch/grid/blob/main/docs/tool-server.md): every grid_ tool

## Use Grid in an assistant

- [All assistants](https://ongrid.example/use/index.html)
- [Claude Code](https://ongrid.example/use/claude-code.html), [Codex](https://ongrid.example/use/codex.html), [Cursor](https://ongrid.example/use/cursor.html), [VS Code and Copilot CLI](https://ongrid.example/use/vscode-copilot-cli.html), [Gemini CLI](https://ongrid.example/use/gemini-cli.html), [Claude Desktop and Cowork](https://ongrid.example/use/claude-desktop-cowork.html)
- Custom connectors, available once the hosted server is live: [Grok](https://ongrid.example/use/grok.html), [Perplexity](https://ongrid.example/use/perplexity.html), [Le Chat](https://ongrid.example/use/le-chat.html)
